providers.plan_floor: Pay as you go; no stated minimum
providers.note: Exa's third arm and a different mechanism from its two search rows: an agent that researches each company at request time, asked the same question with the same output schema. Effort is pinned to medium, which is flat-rate at $0.10 per request and confirmed by every response's costDollars. The API default of effort=auto meters up to $5 per run instead, which would be roughly fifty times the cost across this cohort.

cost_basis_note: estimated_usage_cost_usd is what each provider cost on the frozen 300-domain run. Scale it to the cases a board actually measured: cost * case_count / cost_basis_cases. Observed usage is billing units, not cases, so the scaling is proportional and estimated.
